item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena is grouping the plants growing in her school garden in Jaipur. Which of the following groupings uses a valid basis ( )
A. Rose and tulsi are grouped together because their names have the same number of letters
B. Mango and neem are grouped together because both are believed to bring good luck
C. Hibiscus and sunflower are grouped together because both plants bear flowers
D. Coconut and cactus are grouped together because both are tall plants

options.A: Rose and tulsi are grouped together because their names have the same number of letters
options.B: Mango and neem are grouped together because both are believed to bring good luck
options.C: Hibiscus and sunflower are grouped together because both plants bear flowers
options.D: Coconut and cactus are grouped together because both are tall plants
